title: 第七章：引荐信
content_zh:
烈日当空，灼热着大地，高达三十度的高温，让街道上的行人逐渐稀少。
苏晓顶着烈日走在街道上，四周靠近他的行人，都纷纷皱眉，有些厌恶的看着他。
那辆马车已经被苏晓处理，马也被低价卖掉。
清点完手中的纸币，苏晓叹了口气，这是一种名为贝利的货币，卖掉那匹马他得到十万贝利，听起来很多，实际却只相当于六千rmb的购买力。
请不要高估这十万贝利，它的购买力远低于想象。
苏晓已经尝试后，购买一身不错的衣物，就需要八千贝利贝利，而想要饱餐一顿，大概需要九百贝利。
目光向周围扫视，在发觉四下无人后，苏晓缓走到一间民宅前。
看似随意的选择，实际他已经观察这民宅许久。
民宅虽然不算整洁，但墙壁上并没攀附藤蔓类植物，这说明民宅有人居住，其中的设施完全。
门把手那层细密的灰尘，代表民宅的主人并不经常回到民宅中，只是偶尔回来一次，这是他临时栖身的绝佳选择。
至于为什么不去旅馆或酒馆这类场所居住，是因为那种地方鱼龙混杂，非常容易引起不必要的麻烦。
他来海贼世界是完成任务，现在任务时限只剩六十八个小时，除了任务需要，他不会接触过多的人。
接触太多未知底细的人=麻烦=未知的危险。
再次确定四下无人后，苏晓拿出一些简单的开锁工具。
“咔，咔，咔嚓~。“
房门应声。
仿佛走进自家一般，苏晓进入那间民宅，之后还把门关严。
进入民宅后，和他预想的一样，房间中没有任何人。
这是一间上百平米的民宅，墙壁上挂着一张照片，照片中有一男一女和一名几岁的小女孩，从女主人真诚的笑容就能看出，这是很幸福的一家。
苏晓迅速将衣服脱|光，直奔浴室，虽然他的忍耐力惊人，但身上的恶臭也让他有些作呕。

清水顺着头顶流下，冲走身上的污渍与臭味，换上一身新衣后，苏晓整个人都感觉神清气爽。
坐在沙发上，苏晓手中突然出现一只白色宝箱。
【宝箱（白）是/否开启。】
选择开启，他手中的宝箱悄无声息的
【你开启了宝箱（白），获得以下物品】
【贝利五十万（仅能在本世界使用）】
【城门守卫队长罗文的引荐信】
【乐园币100枚】
只有获得三件物品，收获不算丰厚，但也不错，这毕竟只是白色宝箱，按照‘轮回乐园’的物品等级，白色宝箱只是最低等的宝箱。
最先把贝利收起，现在还用不到这东西，苏晓拿起那封信件。
【城门守卫队长罗文的引荐信】
品质：白色。
类型：触发类道具。
评分：5。（道具评分与装备评分相同。1―10，评分越高的道具，价值越高。）
简介：这是一封慷慨激昂的引荐信，罗文队长滥用手中权利，把一名风车阵的恶霸引荐为侍卫队成员，凭借此信，任何人都可成为侍卫队成员，前提你是一名男性，手中有充足的贝利。
看完手中信件的介绍后，苏晓露出喜色，这正是他想要的东西。
既然不能直接刺杀那位国王，那至少也要见到对方，噩梦级世界的任务难度，可是不是蛮力能解决。
苏晓把所有物品都收入储物空间中，直接从民宅离开。
先是找了一家餐馆饱餐一顿，之后他开始在街道上留意起巡逻的侍卫。
所谓侍卫队，应该就是巡逻街道，惩治一些小偷小摸，虽然权力不大，但也算哥亚王国旗下的权力部门。

跟踪几位侍卫，苏晓很快找到侍卫总部所在，那是一间两层办公楼，门前懒散的站着两名侍卫。
苏晓手中有引荐信，所以直接走上前。
“站住，这里是侍卫队，不得乱闯。”
一名年轻侍卫态度蛮横，在看到苏晓平民打扮后，语气有些高傲。
“我是新来的侍卫……。”
苏晓刚想说出自己的名字，但马上想到，苏晓这个名字在海贼世界有些违和，脑中急转，苏晓继续说道。
“我是新来的侍卫，白夜。”
年轻守卫一愣，上下打量着苏晓。
“白夜？我怎么没说过有新人，你不会是想混进……。”
“里斯！还记得之前队长说的事吗，别多问。白夜，你和我来。”
另一名年长一些的侍卫瞪了年轻侍卫一眼，之后带着苏晓进入身后的侍卫总部。
年轻侍卫愤愤的瞪了苏晓一眼，嘟囔了一句什么。
这种无关紧要的角色，苏晓当然不以理会，跟随着那名年长侍卫，他来到一间办公室前。
“咳咳~。”
年长侍卫挺直身体，整理了一下仪表，刚想敲响房门，房间中就传出一阵急促的喘息声。
苏晓和年长侍卫对视一眼，同时明白房间中正发生什么，年长侍卫放下手，安静的站在一旁。
这时敲响房门明显有些不妥，会打扰年长侍卫顶头上司的雅兴。
年长侍卫对苏晓歉意的笑了笑，苏晓是‘上头’特殊关照的人，所以年长侍卫也不想得罪苏晓。
苏晓和年长侍卫走到一旁，他在怀中掏出一盒香烟，递给年长侍卫一支。
“啪~。”香烟点燃，两人在走廊中闲聊着。

虽然只是一支烟，但却能建立起一些不牢靠的‘友谊’，何乐而不为。
“你小子真是走运，居然有‘上头’关照，放心，你加入侍卫队已经有人打过招呼，完全没问题，对了，我叫汉克，以后我们就是同僚了。”
苏晓谦和的笑了笑，但眼中的情绪却毫无变化。
“我叫白夜，请多关照。”
苏晓说话间，把手中剩余的香烟塞入汉克上衣兜中。
他已经在考虑面前的侍卫是否有利用价值，他现在对王都的情况一概不知，对方有很大用途。
汉克脸上的笑容明显愉悦了一些，就在这时，房间内传出一声短促的低吼。
两人都明白，是时候了。
汉克等了几分钟，敲响房门。
“谁啊，衮进来。”
粗狂的声音在办公室内传出。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
The scorching sun was in the sky, scorching the earth. The high temperature reached 30 degrees, and the number of pedestrians on the street gradually became less and less.
Su Xiao was walking on the street under the scorching sun. The pedestrians who were near him all frowned and looked at him with disgust.
The carriage has been disposed of by Su Xiao, and the horse has been sold at a low price.
After counting the banknotes in his hand, Su Xiao sighed. This is a currency called Bailey. He got 100,000 Baileys from selling the horse, which sounds like a lot, but in reality it is only equivalent to the purchasing power of 6,000 RMB.
Please do not overestimate this 100,000 Baileys, its purchasing power is much lower than imagined.
After Su Xiao had tried it, it would cost 8,000 beli to buy a good set of clothes, and about 900 beri to have a full meal.
Looking around, Su Xiao slowly walked to a private house after realizing that there was no one around.
It seemed like a random choice, but in fact he had been observing this house for a long time.
Although the house is not tidy, there are no vines climbing on the walls, which shows that the house is inhabited and the facilities are complete.
The fine layer of dust on the door handle means that the owner of the house does not often return to the house, but only comes back occasionally. This is an excellent choice for him to stay temporarily.
As for why you don't live in places like hotels or pubs, it's because such places are a mixed bag of good and bad, and it's very easy to cause unnecessary trouble.
He came to the pirate world to complete a mission. Now the mission time limit is only sixty-eight hours. He will not come into contact with too many people except what is required by the mission.
Contact with too many unknown people = trouble = unknown danger.
After once again confirming that no one was around, Su Xiao took out some simple unlocking tools.
"Click, click, click~."
The door answered.
As if walking into her own home, Su Xiao entered the private house and then closed the door tightly.
After entering the house, as he expected, there was no one in the room.
This is a private house of over a hundred square meters. There is a photo hanging on the wall. In the photo, there is a man, a woman and a little girl of several years old. It can be seen from the sincere smile of the hostess that this is a very happy family.
Su Xiao quickly took off his clothes and went straight to the bathroom. Although his endurance was amazing, the stench on his body also made him nauseous.
The clear water flowed down the top of her head, washing away the stains and odor on her body. After putting on new clothes, Su Xiao felt refreshed.
Sitting on the sofa, a white treasure box suddenly appeared in Su Xiao's hand.
[Treasure Chest (White) Yes/No Open. 】
Choosing to open it, the treasure box in his hand quietly
[You opened the treasure chest (white) and obtained the following items]
[Bailey 500,000 (can only be used in this world)]
[Letter of recommendation from city gate guard captain Rowan]
[100 Paradise Coins]
Only three items were obtained. The harvest is not huge, but it is not bad. After all, this is just a white treasure box. According to the item level of the 'Reincarnation Paradise', the white treasure box is only the lowest treasure box.
Bailey was put away first. There was no need for it now. Su Xiao picked up the letter.
[Letter of recommendation from city gate guard captain Rowan]
Quality: white.
Type: Trigger props.
Rating: 5. (The prop score is the same as the equipment score. 1-10. The higher the score, the higher the value.)
Introduction: This is an impassioned letter of recommendation. Captain Rowan abused his power and recommended a bully from Windmill Array as a member of the Guards. With this letter, anyone can become a member of the Guards, provided that you are a male and have enough Baileys in your hands.
After reading the introduction of the letter in his hand, Su Xiao looked happy. This was exactly what he wanted.
Since you can't assassinate the king directly, you must at least see him. The difficulty of the task in the nightmare world cannot be solved by brute force.
Su Xiao put all the items into the storage space and left directly from the house.
First, he found a restaurant for a meal, and then he began to pay attention to patrols on the streets.of guards.
The so-called bodyguards should patrol the streets and punish petty thieves. Although they don't have much power, they can still be regarded as a powerful department under the Kingdom of Goa.
Following several guards, Su Xiao quickly found the headquarters of the guards, which was a two-story office building with two guards standing lazily in front of the door.
Su Xiao had a letter of recommendation in her hand, so she stepped forward directly.
"Stop, this is a guard, no intrusion allowed."
A young guard had an arrogant attitude, and his tone was a bit arrogant after seeing Su Xiao dressed as a civilian.
"I am the new guard..."
Su Xiao just wanted to say his name, but he immediately thought that the name Su Xiao was a bit inconsistent in the world of pirates. His mind raced, and Su Xiao continued.
"I am the new guard, Bai Ye."
The young guard was stunned and looked at Su Xiao up and down.
"Bai Ye? Why didn't I say there was a newcomer? You don't want to sneak in..."
"Reese! Do you still remember what the captain said before? Don't ask any more questions. Bai Ye, come with me."
Another older guard glared at the younger guard, and then led Su Xiao into the guard headquarters behind him.
The young guard glared at Lidya Su angrily and muttered something.
Of course, Su Xiao ignored such an insignificant role and followed the elderly guard to an office.
"Ahem~."
The elderly guard straightened his body, straightened his appearance, and just as he was about to knock on the door, there was a sound of rapid breathing in the room.
Su Xiao and the older guard looked at each other and understood what was happening in the room. The older guard put down his hands and stood quietly aside.
It was obviously inappropriate to knock on the door at this time, as it would disturb the enjoyment of the senior guard's immediate superior.
The elder guard smiled apologetically at Su Xiao. Su Xiao was a person who received special care from 'the superiors', so the elder guard did not want to offend Su Xiao.
Su Xiao and the elderly guard walked aside. He took out a box of cigarettes from his arms and handed one to the elderly guard.
"Pah~." The cigarette was lit and the two chatted in the corridor.
Although it's just a cigarette, it can build some unstable 'friendships', so why not do it.
"You're so lucky, kid, to have someone taking care of you. Don't worry, someone has already said hello to you when you join the Guards. It's no problem at all. By the way, my name is Hank, and we will be colleagues from now on."
Su Xiaoqian smiled gently, but the emotion in his eyes did not change.
"My name is Bai Ye, please take care of me."
As Su Xiao spoke, she put the remaining cigarette in Hank's jacket pocket.
He was already considering whether the guard in front of him had any use value. He didn't know anything about the situation in the royal capital, and the guard in front of him had great use.
The smile on Hank's face became obviously a little happier, and at this moment, a short growl came from the room.
Both knew it was time.
Hank waited a few minutes and knocked on the door.
"Who is it? Come in."
A rough voice came from the office.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
